readme: Registry of automations + critical outputs the health-heartbeat.ps1 watches for SILENT DEATH - an automation that stopped being scheduled (deleted/disabled), or an output that quietly went stale, WITHOUT a loud failure. Distinct from local-watchdog (browser-store staleness) and the GitHub Actions failure email (loud cloud failures). EVERY 'SMP *' Windows task belongs here - health-heartbeat's REGISTRY DRIFT check pages if one is missing. max_age_hours ~30 tolerates a late run + a weekend gap on a daily thing. Optional 'proves' (path or glob, repo-relative) names the output that shows the task's WORK actually landed: a nonzero exit whose proof output is fresh is reported as a warning, not paged as a death (2026-07-28 - the Baker's task was being terminated by a battery condition while its data refreshed fine, which paged Brad for a non-outage). Since 2026-08-06 the proof must ALSO be no older than the run it claims to prove, because max_age_hours is wider than a daily task's own period and yesterday's output was excusing a run that never happened at all.
